agent_note: First-person narrator, extremely aphorism-heavy sample. Zero quotation marks survived in any of the 26 quotes, so dialogue was assigned only where vocatives ('Sallie'), interjections/echoes ('Quality? Hell'), sustained second-person address, or conversational discourse markers appear; that signal choice is recorded per quote. Notably there is NO present-tense scene or action narration anywhere in the sample — every present event quote is narrating-now commentary or a reflective state ('the harder I try', 'Now that I have one of those jobs, I see'), while the only two actual event-narration quotes ('She also lent me her books', 'She also told me') are past. That pattern reads as a retrospective first-person narrator with a heavy present-tense commentary habit rather than simultaneous narration, but the sample is thin on scene narration and the past/present count alone (2/8) points the other way, so the narrating-situation call rests on the kind of present rather than the amount of it.
